decidedBy: the user, 2026-10-13: learn only from the work done creating eoreader and the Fold, all of it, scoped by the PATH of each code edit (never by prompt wording)
rule: an edit is IN iff some directory segment of its file_path matches an `in` pattern and none matches an `out` pattern or names a `tier2` directory; anything else is OUT. A turn is IN only if every one of its code edits is IN; a turn mixing IN and OUT code edits is withheld whole as withheld:mixed-scope. A turn with no code edit is judged on all its edits.
tier2Note: default OUT until the user decides; the user confirmed 2026-10-13 that they stay OUT
primaryRootNote: accounting only: how many IN edits sit outside the main checkout (Default Project, New Project, 2.0, /tmp worktrees). Not a rule.
